auction.terms_default:
1. To take part you must be registered and have accepted these terms. A bid is a commitment to buy the lot at the price you bid.

2. Bids are placed for the whole lot (all drives) and cannot be withdrawn. A bid in the last 2 minutes extends the auction by another 2 minutes.

3. When a lot asks for a deposit, bids are accepted after the deposit is confirmed. Deposits are refunded in full to everyone who does not win; the winner's deposit counts towards the purchase.

4. The winner contacts us within 24 hours of the end and starts the 30/70 payment: a 30% advance, then the 70% balance once the drives are tested and the results confirmed. A winner who does not pay in time forfeits the deposit and may be excluded from future auctions.

5. Shill bids, bidding from several accounts and collusion with other bidders are forbidden — such bids are cancelled.

6. The drives' condition (new / used / refresh), test result and warranty are stated on the lot. Delivery works as described under “Payment & delivery”.

7. The shop may pause or cancel an auction when necessary; deposits already paid are then refunded.
